feeds.title: Curierul National

feeds.title: ADZ News
feeds.description: Adz.ro is the only German-language daily newspaper in Central and Eastern Europe. It provides information about Romania as a whole and about the German minority living here.

feeds.title: Krónika
feeds.description: As the leading body of the Hungarian press market in Transylvania, the basic philosophy of the Chronicle is to provide a comprehensive and authentic picture of the reality and events in Romania, especially in Transylvania, at the highest possible professional level.
